decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory tied to the installed trailer base, it likely meets modest aspirations or uses so little organisational slack that management keeps it.

This box car trailer series remains close to the firm's core market and capabilities, so without clear evidence of underperformance management would continue it despite some risk of later portfolio pruning.
After four years, a niche car transporter line with no recent visible prominence would more likely be judged below aspiration and its resources redirected to stronger core or new products.
The low-bed trailer series still fits professional hauling needs and the firm's production and service strengths, so management would likely allow it to remain in the portfolio.

Because this second box car trailer series overlaps with other offerings and has had enough time to prove itself, management would now be inclined to rationalise the range if performance is not clearly above aspiration.
